name: Elemental Transfiguration: Lava Blessing
description:
Elemental Transfiguration: Pyro Geo
Roll Phase: Always roll 2 Pyro Dice and 2 Geo Dice.
After you trigger a Pyro Crystallize reaction: Discard this card, then choose either Lava Blessing: Turnfire or Lava Blessing: Remelting and add it to your Hand.
